This amendment supplies the missing retained producers and closed effect primitive; it does not add a generic helper, caller selector, transport, platform or R6 behavior.

global_install_provenance.mode: root:wheel 0444 canonical JSON; no secrets; authenticity is root ownership, no-follow parent/file identity, exact bytes and absent-or-exact publication
global_install_provenance.producer: The MAC branch of scripts/substrate/dev-install-substrate.sh writes it only after prefix control binary, fixed privileged executor, LaunchDaemon plist and managed-copy records are durable. Repeat install accepts exact bytes only; mismatch/partial state blocks without overwrite or adoption.

fixed executor path /Library/PrivilegedHelperTools/com.substrate.lifecycle.publisher.v1 plus descriptor identity/digest/code identity/requirement

Prefix-local executor copies are non-authorizing convenience only. The fixed control image remains the prefix bin path recorded by provenance.

direct_bootstrap_and_capsule.minimal_request: The hidden direct command accepts only a canonical MacPublisherBootstrapRequestV1 containing the exact IH carrier. Any legacy manifest, scope, source/build, profile, action, Stage-1, PM, path or authority field rejects. The trusted measured control image reads the root-owned install provenance and allocates scope/attempt/nonces/times itself after terminal confirmation.
direct_bootstrap_and_capsule.authorization: Construct PublisherBootstrapAuthorizationV1 entirely from decoded IH, retained install provenance, secure UUIDv7/nonces and bounded issued/expiry times. Construct the canonical generation-one pre-PM mac_host_shared/mac_lima manifest internally: PM absent, entries/receipts empty, principal/IH/source/build exact. Include the full canonical pre-PM manifest in the retained FD3 authorization or an exact nested capsule field; its digest must equal the authorization manifest identity. Caller seed bytes are never authority.
direct_bootstrap_and_capsule.record: MacLimaStageOneCapsuleV1 in a fixed per-scope System-Keychain account, separate from LifecyclePublisherProtectedStateV1
creation_order: validate FD3 peer and install provenance
construct/validate full pre-PM manifest and bootstrap authorization
construct and sign one-use LimaStageOneAuthorizationV1 using the same System-Keychain P-256 key

persist capsule absent-or-exact and exact-join pre-PM manifest bytes/digest, bootstrap authorization digest, initial anchor digest/counter, Stage-1 authorization/template/profile, install provenance digest and state revision
return the signed Stage-1 authorization in the bounded direct-bootstrap response
direct_bootstrap_and_capsule.replay: The returned Stage-1 authorization is public carrier data but one-use authority comes from signature plus the exact current capsule/anchor state. Replay after Prepared/Completed or any mismatch blocks.

stage_one_profile.source: A versioned canonical profile template embedded in substrate-lifecycle-macos.rs; no caller path, LIMA_PROFILE_PATH, PROJECT_PATH, environment, repository lookup or scripts/mac/lima/substrate.yaml input.
render_inputs: fixed instance name and fixed image/template constants only
stage_one_profile.contents: Minimal Lima realization only. It may write one fixed root-owned guest Stage-1 attempt marker containing attempt_id and capsule digest so crash/retry can prove this exact create. It must not install packages, alter DNS, stage project files, create publisher/world components or perform post-PM guest projection.
stage_one_profile.binding: Install provenance binds template algorithm/version/digest. The signed Stage-1 authorization carries canonical rendered profile bytes as base64url plus rendered SHA-256; executor re-renders and requires byte equality before effect.

closed_lima_effect.owner: execute_mac_managed_action_v1 StageOne branch in the fixed privileged executor only
closed_lima_effect.tool: Open the provenance-recorded limactl executable no-follow, verify descriptor identity/digest/code identity/version immediately before use, and execute only that fixed tool. No PATH-selected or caller-selected executable.
closed_lima_effect.config: Write the internally re-rendered signed profile to one root-owned, no-follow, attempt-scoped file below the fixed lifecycle state root; fsync file/parent and record identity in the capsule before spawn. This is an executor-owned transaction artifact, not a request/file carrier.
closed_lima_effect.environment: Clear inherited selection variables. Set exact HOME and LIMA_HOME from the decoded IH/account-database-derived control root; construct PATH only from the recorded limactl parent plus fixed system directories.
closed_commands: limactl list <fixed-instance> --json for exact absence/status proof
limactl start --tty=false --name <fixed-instance> <executor-owned-profile-path> for the sole create/start effect
limactl shell <fixed-instance> -- <fixed literal observation command> for marker, /etc/machine-id, account, uid and account-database home observation
closed_lima_effect.observation: After start, strictly parse and reobserve twice: exact instance/status, fixed attempt marker, lowercase 32-hex machine ID, guest account, positive UID and account-database home. The allowed post-effect observation tuple is LimaStageOneObservationV1, not guest_machine_id alone. Derive PlatformBootstrapMappingV1 only from this exact tuple plus signed IH/template.
forbidden: guest provisioning beyond the fixed attempt marker

retry_and_completion.before_effect: Capsule Issued/Prepared plus proven absence may continue. Persist EffectStarted before spawn.
retry_and_completion.after_effect: If instance is absent, exact same attempt may retry create. If present, resume only when fixed marker, instance and all reobserved identity fields exact-join the capsule; otherwise PreservingBlocked. Never adopt based on name or apparent profile bytes.
retry_and_completion.ambiguous: Timeout/unknown status/partial marker/mismatch preserves instance and capsule and returns the closed blocked result; no delete/recreate.
retry_and_completion.completion: Use the 0029 specialized source-generation N to PM-generation N+1 manifest/receipt/index/head/anchor/protected-state/admission CAS. Persist Completed only after every durable join. Generic same-generation actions remain unchanged.
